headline: Nikola Jokic rallies Nuggets from 23 down, says booing fans 'not welcome anymore'

headline: Pistons C Jalen Duren out at least two weeks with hamstring strain

headline: Sixers overrule Embiid, sit center with plantar fasciitis management
description: Despite publicly calling to play Sunday against the Pistons, the 76ers decided to sit Joel Embiid due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.

headline: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz
description: — Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

headline: Haliburton has 24 points and 10 assists as the Pacers beat the winless Nets 136-109
description: — Tyrese Haliburton had 24 points, 10 assists and an All-Star Game-worthy dunk as the Indiana Pacers hammered the Brooklyn Nets 136-109 on Sunday night.

headline: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points, with 8 3s, in Lakers' win vs. Jazz
